children: A.O. Smith raised its quarterly cash dividend to 38 cents a share, from 36 cents.
The new dividend, equal to $1.52 a year, represents an annual yield of 2.7% based on Monday's closing price of $56.60.
The heating and water treatment company plans to pay the dividend on Nov. 16 to shareholders of record as of Oct. 30.
